SCOPE = the pa-kpi-hero-list CONTAINER (card shell + header + body/layout-grid + footer) the component emits; the hero panel comes from the sibling kpi_hero_main/1 (required inner_block slot) and the supporting tiles from kpi_hero_side/1 (the `rail` slot) — the dumper renders slot content as plain text, so only container features are mapped here, and the .pa-kpi-hero-main*/.pa-kpi-hero-side* blocks (plus __rail) are deferred in the oracle fixture. The container has NO block-level modifiers; `layout` is an element modifier on __layout. NOTE: keen's `hero_split` attr takes underscored values (2_3/3_4) but internally dasherizes (_->-), so the oracle's dashed value (2-3/3-4) passes through unchanged and produces the same `pa-kpi-hero-list__layout--hero-{value}` class. `footer` maps to the plain-string `footer_text` attr (not the `footer` slot) so the harness exercises the <span>-wrapped caption shape. The LIVE pill label defaults to 'LIVE' (live_text, unset here) and is intentionally omitted from the shared oracle contract.
